answer: Each epoch a river of 40,000 credits fills one fixed pool, split equally among valid claims. Each claim moors at a public jetty: one key, one claim, a 40-credit fee burned and a 70-credit bond locked. A nebula of auditors samples 5% of claims each epoch; a rented claim burns its bond. Against 200 honest identities, 1,000 fakes burn 40,000 in fees yet capture at most 33,333, a loss, while one honest identity pays 40 once and keeps its full share.
